thread:
Marco: Heads-up team 1: we need a full dry-run of the SI onboarding flow (marketplace listing -> cert -> lab access -> joint announcement rehearsals). Can someone volunteer to run the checklist Mon morning?
Jin: I can run the cert rubric review. I want a short SLA for review turnaround (48h) and a sample assignment for hands-on.
Priya: I'll curate the hands-on assignment. Thinking a short integration task: deploy a connector and run a sample inference pipeline. Should be ~45m.
Nina: For HW partners we should include a compatibility stamp on the listing. I'll create a 1-pager mapping SKUs to tested drivers.
Leo: Marketplace side: I need final logos, one-line partner blurbs, and the co-marketing slug. Can partners provide vector logos by EOD Mon?
Marco: Yes ask partners for SVG + partner point-of-contact. We'll consolidate.
infra-bot: Sandbox fleet status: 120 seats available in us-west, image tag `rw/si-dryrun:2026-03-16`. Quota risk if >150 concurrent.
Priya: Good note. I'll cap lab assignments to 100. Can infra queue handle spikes?
infra-bot: Auto-burst disabled for this fleet. File ticket if you need permanent increases.
Jin: Cert rubric draft (high-level):
- Prereq docs read: 1 hour
- Hands-on exercise: pass automated tests (unit + integration)
- Live Q&A: 20 min slot with training SME
Pass = badge + voucher for sandbox seats
I'll post the checklist doc in 30m.
Priya: For the exercise tests, can we include a hw-compat check? Example script: `./check_hw_compat --model t5 --gpu a100`
Nina: Yes include that; I'll provide driver versions matrix.
Leo: I've drafted marketplace copy. Quick ask: do we have co-branding rules for hardware partners? Marketing needs the one-liner policy.
Marco: Partnerships will own co-branding approvals. I'll run a 15-min approval sync Tue.
product-bot: Marketplace validator: missing fields -> `co_marketing_slug`, `partner_logo_svg` reported for listing draft.
Leo: Uploading assets now to /shared/marketplace/si-partners/leo-upload
product-bot: Watching folder. Will re-run validations on upload.
Priya: Webinar dry-run plan: Tue 10am PT (internal), Wed 9am PT (partner facing rehearsal). We'll record and capture Qs.
Marco: Great. Also we should prepare a customer intro kit (1-pager + setup commands + sample prompts). Who owns that?
Priya: Training team will own the kit. I'll include setup commands and a quick troubleshooting FAQ.
Jin: One more item: cert roster API needs to return reasons for failure so redemption UI can surface it. Example response field: `fail_reason` with values like `missing_docs`, `failed_hw_check`.
Marco: Good. @infra-bot please create a short ticket to enable the cert lookup endpoint for the redemption flow.
infra-bot: Ticket INF-9812 created: "Enable cert lookup API for SI redemption" ETA 48h.
Nina: For hardware partners, let's add a small note on the listing: "Tested with drivers X.Y.Z on SKUs A/B/C" so users know expected performance envelope.
Leo: I'll add a bullet in the marketplace blurb: "Hardware compatibility: see partner one-pager".
Marco: Final coordinated launch checklist for dry-run (short):
- Cert rubric published + API endpoint (owner: Jin)
- Hands-on assignment + tests (owner: Priya)
- HW compatibility one-pager (owner: Nina)
- Marketplace assets + validation (owner: Leo)
- Sandbox seats reserved and image pushed (owner: infra)
- Internal dry-run + partner rehearsal scheduled (owner: Marco)

Marco: If everyone is OK, I'll lock owners and post the master runbook link later. Thanks! :rocket:
